final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and instead reframed the same record more narrowly. That reframing is materially better than an unconditional certification claim, but it still does not establish present compliance. Under the policy text, certification may proceed only if the current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and the material segment weakness is disclosed or covered by approved mitigation. The Actor expressly concedes the record does not prove current documentation has been updated and does not show release-specific mitigation or risk acceptance. That means this is not yet `compliant_with_caveats`: the caveat is the missing policy prerequisite itself, not a bounded residual risk on top of an already-satisfied compliance condition. Aggregate readiness, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and public guidance support a possible path to compliant certification, but they do not satisfy the current certification predicate on the present admissible record.
